 Availability Report 
 Availability report: Only one 5-Stripe listed as ineligible for Saturday's clash with Chicago Fire
 Managing Editor
 Adam Jasper
 Copy URL 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on X 
 Head coach Tata Martino said as much Thursday, and today it was confirmed there will only be one player for Atlanta United Saturday. The 5-Stripes are set to take on Chicago Fire at 7:30 p.m. ET tomorrow night , and just Will Reilly will be unavailable. 
 The Homegrown midfielder has been listed as out on Friday's availability report as he continues to recover from an ankle injury. Martino said it will be an injury that keeps him out for the remainder of the 2026 season. 
 Atlanta United will still have a squad with almost everyone present for the matchup against Chicago, who sit in fourth place in the Eastern Conference and have already qualified for the Audi MLS Cup Playoffs. The 5-Stripes are still vying for a playoff spot themselves, and they'll need a win to keep that hope within reach.
